title: Reduce inequality within and among countries
description: Goal 10 calls for reducing inequalities in income, as well as those based on sex, age, disability, race, class, ethnicity, religion and opportunity—both within and among countries. It also aims to ensure safe, orderly and regular migration and addresses issues related to representation of developing countries in global decision-making and development assistance.

targets.title: By 2030, progressively achieve and sustain income growth of the bottom 40 per cent of the population at a rate higher than the national average
targets.description: By 2030, progressively achieve and sustain income growth of the bottom 40 per cent of the population at a rate higher than the national average

indicators.description: Growth rates of household expenditure or income per capita among the bottom 40 per cent of the population and the total population

targets.description: By 2030, empower and promote the social, economic and political inclusion of all, irrespective of age, sex, disability, race, ethnicity, origin, religion or economic or other status

indicators.description: Proportion of people living below 50 per cent of median income, by sex, age and persons with disabilities
